framing.title: How many Puy-de-Dôme communes each PDO cheese covers

subtitle.html: For milk and cheese-making, the Fourme d'Ambert area is the largest, 292 communes; the Saint-Nectaire production zone has 49.
subtitle.text: For milk and cheese-making, the Fourme d'Ambert area is the largest, 292 communes; the Saint-Nectaire production zone has 49.

option.label: Milk production and cheese-making
option.definition: The communes where the milk may be produced and the cheese made. Only the Saint-Nectaire specification separates this zone from the geographic area; for the other five appellations, it is the same area.
option.text: milk production and cheese-making; only Saint-Nectaire changes, its production zone covers 49 communes of the département instead of 463; the other five appellations have a single area

notes: Only four plots of Sayat lie within the Cantal area and the Salers area; it is counted as a whole commune, as in the INAO list.
legend.perimeter: the 463 communes of Puy-de-Dôme in the 2025 official geographic code; 7 former codes of the INAO list counted in their current commune, which is already listed; Sayat, partly within the Cantal and Salers area, counted whole
